Type: rug
Name: Rivet Textured Neutral Chevron Cotton Rug, 8' x 10', Grey
Colors: Grey
Materials: cotton
100% Cotton Imported This modern take on the coastal aesthetic creates an impactful focal point in any space. Hand-woven from soft cotton in a durable flat weave, it casually completes the places where you live your life most. Area rug features a nautical-inspired design Hand-woven with 100% cotton fibers Medium, .65'' pile suits high-traffic, transitional indoor areas Pair with a rug pad (sold separately) 8' x 10' Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow a few days for natural fibers to settle
